SMTO-KV-0002 — The agent lost its place while listing its notes

GUID: 3df8f0bd-8cc2-4aa2-91f0-f515e566bdb4
Slug: kv-invalid-cursor
Domain: KV · Subsystem: kv

What happened

  • The agent was going through its saved task notes page by page, but the marker it used for the next page doesn't belong to this list. Nothing was changed; the list just needs to start again from the first page.

How to fix — simple steps

  1. Let the agent continue; it usually starts the list again from the first page. Starting over gives it a fresh, valid marker for each following page.
  2. If it happens again, tell the agent to list its notes from the start and keep the same filter for every page. A page marker only works with the exact filter it came from.

What success looks like

  • The agent lists its notes without this error.

If it still fails

  • Select Copy error details and send them to the person who manages SMTO. Don't ask the agent to repeat the same page request unchanged.

Technical details

Observed condition

  • Agent KV list rejected the cursor: it could not be decoded, has the wrong version, belongs to a different prefix, or its after-key is invalid or outside that prefix.

What this means

  • Listing cannot decode a bounded cursor or its version, prefix, after-key or normalized key does not match this enumeration. KV checks apply only to the selected conversation. Rejected validation or compare-and-set does not authorize an unconditional replacement; diagnostics do not read or mutate additional stored values.

Why this can happen

  • Listing cannot decode a bounded cursor or its version, prefix, after-key or normalized key does not match this enumeration.

How to diagnose it

  • Compare the selected prefix with the cursor's issuing request without constructing replacement tokens by hand.

How to fix it

  • Restart kv__list from the first page (no cursor) with the same prefix and pass back only the cursor returned for that prefix. Do not reuse a cursor with a different prefix or construct one by hand.
  • Restart enumeration or query from the first page and use the new returned cursor.

Retry and execution caution

  • Apply the correction and confirm the relevant state before requesting another attempt. Prior completed work remains governed by its receipts.

How to verify the fix

  • A fresh first page and its returned cursor enumerate the same prefix successfully.

What not to do

  • Do not submit a stale identifier or revision after another actor changed the resource.

Technical notes

  • KV checks apply only to the selected conversation. Rejected validation or compare-and-set does not authorize an unconditional replacement; diagnostics do not read or mutate additional stored values.
  • Preserve the occurrence ID and safe request/operation references. Receipts and occurrence facts establish what started or completed; the catalog does not authorize retries or establish execution outcome.
